name: B10-0133/2024 (Verts/ALE) – Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
title: Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Azerbaijan to release jailed activists, journalists and critics, and to stop torturing and intimidating people. It asks the European Union to make energy cooperation with Azerbaijan conditional on releasing political prisoners and improving human rights, and to consider sanctions on those responsible. It also says Azerbaijan should not use hosting the COP29 climate summit to hide its rights record. Separately, it welcomes peace talks between Armenia and Azerbaijan. The text is the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking the EU and Azerbaijan to act.
- **Who it affects:** Azerbaijan's government, jailed activists, EU energy deals, COP29 delegates.
- **What happens next:** The EU Commission and Council decide whether to act on these requests.
